    Medoc - Advanced Medical Systems

    Medoc has been the leader in developing quantitative sensory (QST) devices for the past three decades. Our FDA approved and EU - MDR CE certified devices allow for comprehensive thermal, pressure and vibratory QST and are used throughout the world, delivering top end sensory testing data. 

    ​
